decision.description: allow lets the call proceed, delegating to the next hook or the default policy; auto_approve approves the call where the default policy would prompt, while honoring explicit user-configured rules; deny hard-blocks; ask prompts but respects Always Allow; force_ask always prompts, ignoring cached permissions; deny_unless_prior_grant denies unless a prior grant covers the resource.

reason.description: Explanation shown to the agent or user for the decision.

overwrite.description: Replacement arguments shallow-merged at the top level into toolCall.args before execution; when arguments change, a notice naming the changed keys is prepended to the tool result.

permissionOverrides.description: Permission resources in action(target) form, for example read_file(/path) or command(npm test), that override default tool permissions.
